summary: Practise fair concern responses, manager conversations and engagement action planning. Explore the five-day employee relations course.
lede: Employee relations training courses help HR practitioners and people managers respond fairly to workplace concerns and support engagement. For foundation-level learners, the course covers concern triage, neutral case notes and SBI feedback conversations, with practice in agreeing next steps and tracking follow-up. It also introduces employee listening, engagement indicators such as eNPS, and action planning for everyday and hybrid-team situations.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who handle employee concerns, manager conversations or engagement actions as part of their regular work. It is designed for foundation-level learners seeking practical routines rather than specialist investigation or advanced workforce analytics.
prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is specified. No coding is required; basic familiarity with workplace or people-management situations will help you engage with the scenarios.
